  A.national_registry,
  A.id AS person_id_dock,
  B.id_person AS person_id_basecadastral,
  C.id AS address_id_dock,
  C.city as address_city_dock,
  D.id_person_address AS address_id_basecadastral
FROM prd.trusted_dock_view.dview_people_snapshot A
LEFT JOIN prd.trusted_base_cadastral_view.dview_person_snapshot B
ON A.id = B.id_person
LEFT JOIN prd.trusted_dock_view.dview_address_snapshot C
ON A.id = C.person_id
LEFT JOIN prd.trusted_base_cadastral_view.dview_person_address_snapshot D
ON B.id_person = D.fk_person
WHERE A.national_registry IN (08439728581)"}]}]}
